verdict.rationale: The SES API v2 SendEmail docs describe a 'Templated' message type in which SES replaces personalization tags with values you supply, so sending by template with a variable payload is documented. Nothing in the pack shows API operations to create or update templates, and nothing shows template versioning. Older community comments say you must handle templating yourself, but these are general remarks rather than a concrete counter-example, so they lower confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented create/update template API, template versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of templated sends.
